raw: {"analysis":"Response FMP incorrectly states that reverting triggers a one-hour deployment freeze, then later says the freeze restriction lifts automatically upon successful completion—this is internally inconsistent and not supported by the repository facts. Response ZCR correctly treats the freeze as a consequence of rollback, assigns clear ownership for each lane, handles the flaky certificate-validation check with a sensible escalation policy, and properly sequences the dual-sign-off (Security Lead + Platform Director) with Jane Smith's merge authority. ZCR also addresses cipher suite specification and audit compliance, which FMP omits.","verdict":"ZCR"}
